source: NASA/JPL Horizons (ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/horizons): heliocentric ecliptic J2000 state vectors, AU and AU/day

craft.name: Voyager 1
craft.about: Launched 1977. Flew past Jupiter and Saturn; the most distant human-made object, in interstellar space since 2012.

craft.name: Voyager 2
craft.about: Launched 1977. The only spacecraft to visit Uranus and Neptune; in interstellar space since 2018.

craft.name: Pioneer 10
craft.about: Launched 1972. First spacecraft to cross the asteroid belt and fly past Jupiter. Contact lost in 2003.

craft.name: Pioneer 11
craft.about: Launched 1973. First spacecraft to fly past Saturn. Contact lost in 1995.

craft.name: New Horizons
craft.about: Launched 2006. Flew past Pluto in 2015 and the Kuiper belt object Arrokoth in 2019.

craft.name: Parker Solar Probe
craft.about: Launched 2018. Dives through the Sun’s corona; the fastest human-made object.

craft.name: James Webb Space Telescope
craft.about: Launched 2021. Infrared observatory orbiting the Sun–Earth L2 point, 1.5 million km from Earth.

craft.name: Europa Clipper
craft.about: Launched 2024. On its way to Jupiter’s moon Europa (arrival 2030).

craft.name: JUICE
craft.about: ESA’s Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer, launched 2023 (arrival 2031).

craft.name: Lucy
craft.about: Launched 2021. Touring the Trojan asteroids that share Jupiter’s orbit.

craft.name: Psyche
craft.about: Launched 2023. Bound for the metal-rich asteroid 16 Psyche (arrival 2029).

craft.name: Cassini
craft.about: Orbited Saturn 2004–2017, ending with a dive into Saturn.

craft.name: Galileo
craft.about: Orbited Jupiter 1995–2003, ending with a dive into Jupiter.

craft.name: Rosetta
craft.about: ESA mission that orbited comet 67P 2014–2016 and landed Philae on it.
